title: App Shell & Integration — Editor Layout, Home Screen, Full Wiring
description: Replace the starter App.tsx with the full editor application. Create EditorLayout component that composes all panels: Toolbar (top), LayerPanel (left sidebar), Viewport (center), Inspector (right sidebar), PromptChat (bottom or overlay). Create HomeScreen/Welcome screen with recent projects and new project option. Wire up all stores (ThemeStore, ProjectStore, UIStore) and providers (ThemeProvider, StoreProvider). Update main.tsx to include all providers. Ensure proper routing between Home and Editor views.
acceptance_criteria: App.tsx replaced with full editor application
EditorLayout composes Toolbar, LayerPanel, Viewport, Inspector, PromptChat
CSS Grid or Flexbox layout with resizable panels
HomeScreen with welcome message, new project button, theme toggle
Navigation between Home and Editor views via UIStore state
All providers (ThemeProvider, StoreProvider) wrapped in main.tsx
Drag-and-drop image files from filesystem into viewport/layer panel
Project save/load via toolbar or menu using IPC
completion_summary: App shell complete. EditorLayout with CSS Grid composing Toolbar/LayerPanel/Viewport/Inspector/PromptChat. HomeScreen with new project, load project, API key config. App.tsx routes via UIStore.showHomeScreen. main.tsx wraps with ThemeProvider+StoreProvider. Typecheck and build pass.
